dedupe_keys.name: datasets on climate change impact and reallocation strategies for federal reservoirs in texas

description: Datasets on Climate Change Impact and Reallocation Strategies for Federal Reservoirs in Texas is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Zeng, Ruijie (deposited on HydroShare). This is for the manuscript "Assessing the Effectiveness of Reservoir Operation and Identifying Reallocation Opportunities under Climate Change". Climate change will alter hydroclimatic variability, bringing a set of challenges to existing water management. It remains unclear if current water infrastructure and operational strategies will still be effective in the future. Coverage: Texas, United States. The resource was created 2024-02-28 and last updated 2024-06-05; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
